decision: Scan set = Drive 'Toyota Sera' (1IYHb1b8NgPtv6tds1RgQw93zBKLVUPdm), all 2025-02-15/19 Artec exports; full car = 'Toyota Sera Full car.stl' (15.0M tris); fetched every state/part scan except Low Definition and the two underbody halves
why: Full car is the highest-res whole-car capture; Low Definition is a lower-res duplicate; underbody halves are never seen in a scan-on-black reel. Door Open is a bonus state (Sera butterfly doors) for the 'panels open' beat

decision: One rigid levelling transform (RANSAC ground plane -> +Z, long axis -> Y, flip so nose = -Y) fitted on the 4 mm full car and applied to every state scan (projects/huracan-evo/tools/level.py; /home/user/media/toyota-sera/level.json)
why: Raw Artec frame tilted 2.7 deg and yawed 17 deg; one shared transform keeps all states registered. Sanity check: body length above hub height 3,839 mm vs Sera spec 3,860 mm; height 1,250 mm vs 1,265 mm

decision: Canonical frame = ive prep of clean/car4.stl (mm->m, centred, floor z=0) -> prep/car4.json; every other mesh prepped with --like car4.json
why: Lesson: never re-normalise a part separately; Ferrari/A90 siblings did the same

decision: 'Rear Bumper Removed.stl' and 'Rear Bumper Removed No Tail Lights.stl' are byte-identical (md5 9592a121...); treated as one state
why: Both prepped to the same 549,352 faces; checked md5 before choosing a rear base so the 'no tail lights' name isn't relied on

decision: Numeric registration (tools/regcheck.py, 3 mm): every state scan sits 0.8-1.3 mm median from the full car (ICP would move <=2.5 mm); part scans front bumper 3.0 mm, rear bumper 3.1 mm, light 1.3 mm (ICP offers 6/16/28 mm)
why: Artec states share the full car's frame; separate part scans need the visual overlay before deciding on any correction

decision: Hood + both butterfly doors animate on hinges fitted to the open-state captures (tools/hinge_fit.py): hood axis -X, 56.0 deg, lands 1.49 mm median on 'Hood open'; doors axes (+-0.60, 0.68, 0.41), 56.2 / -57.0 deg, 1.05 / 1.04 mm on 'Door Open'
why: Physically right motion from the data instead of guessed pivots; the two door fits came out mirror-symmetric independently, which confirms them. Rendered closed/half/open over the base and looked

decision: Panels = outer skin from the full car + the open capture's other triangles (hood frame, door trim) swung back through the inverse hinge; bases drop every open-panel triangle of the state scan
why: First try left the open hood's inner frame floating in the base and showed the far door already open (Door Open has both doors up). Fit the +X door too so both open together

decision: Exploded base (tools/explode_base.py) = full car minus hood/door skins and both bumpers (+ bumper-mounted plates) + front/rear bumper-removed, hood-open (hood dropped) and door-open (doors dropped) states as captured; flying panels = front bumper + rear bumper part scans, hood, both doors
why: Brief: build the exploded view from part scans + removed states and pin every transform with --like; renders over the car showed all five registered. Licence plates aren't in the bumper part scans, so they'd have floated in the base

decision: Spoiler left on the body (not exploded); 'light' and 'steered right' scans not used
why: 'Spoiler removed' is a patchy partial capture with no hatch glass, so cutting the spoiler out would leave holes; 'light' is two small fragments, 'steered right' a partial front corner

decision: shot.py disables Cycles persistent data whenever a shot has animated parts (s5, s6, s8)
why: Sibling huracan-evo found scenes going unlit mid-shot with persistent data + animated objects (hinges and translations)

decision: Shot list (Temerario order): s1 low front 3/4 turntable -> s2 rear 3/4 orbit -> s3 front wheel extreme close-up -> s4 nose/headlamp slide -> s5 hood opens -> s6 both butterfly doors open -> s7 rise to top-down -> s8 exploded view (separate, orbit, reassemble) -> logo card
why: Brief order; the Sera's butterfly doors are its signature, so the 'panels open' beat gets a hood shot AND a doors shot; no text, scan only

decision: Framing tightened after 30% previews: turntable radius 4.7->3.8 m, hood 4.0->3.6, doors 5.0->4.5, top-down start closer; tail-lamp detail replaced by a nose/headlamp slide; explode panels stack above the car (hood +1.35 m, bumpers +0.75/0.85 m up and only 0.35 m out, doors 0.45 m out + 0.65 m up, swung 35 %), camera 5.6-6.9 m
why: Car read small in 9:16 (240SX lesson); the tail panel read flat with a blank plate dominating; first explode layout flew bumpers/hood out of the portrait frame - Temerario floats panels in layers above the car

decision: Music = toyota-sera_track.mp3 (original track generated for this reel by the parent session: retro-futurist Japanese synth). Kick grid 0.0355 + 0.59999 n = 100.0 BPM (59 kicks, 4.3 ms rms); 8-beat phrases (low band steps up every other 8 beats) at 0.036/4.835/9.635/14.435/19.235/24.035/28.835/33.635; kick break beats 42-46 (25.2-27.6 s); music stops at 38.435 s, -30 dB by 39.09 s
why: tools/accents.py: kick peaks 40-120 Hz least squares (FG2 lesson), per-beat RMS/low-band/onset; parent measured ~99 BPM and end ~38.5 s - agrees

Phrase downbeats carry the big changes (turntables, close-ups, explode); hood and doors get 5 and 7 beats so each opening finishes on a beat (hood beats 1-4, doors 1-5) and holds vary (240SX lesson); trimmed to where the music ends, not the 40.05 s file length

decision: Explode separates ON the 24.035 s phrase downbeat (shot start), eases out 3 beats, drifts through the kick break, flies home from beat 12 and LOCKS on the 33.635 s phrase downbeat, holds 2 beats, logo at 34.835 s
why: The separation and the reassembly are the reel's two biggest moments; both land on phrase downbeats where the bass steps up

decision: Hood panel rebuilt: inner frame kept only where it sits >3 mm below the closed skin (--inner-below); closed-hood candidates landing within 30 mm also join the panel (--land-loose 30); s5 and s8 re-rendered
why: s5 final contact sheet: the open capture's own outer skin poked through the closed hood as dark ridges, and nose skin strips (weaker fit there, 20 mm truncated cost) stayed on the base as layers while the hood lifted. Checked frames 1/18/30 at final quality after the fix

decision: v1 assembled (39.27 s, cuts measured at -2 ms from every beat); explode orbit tightened 5.6-6.9 m -> 5.2-6.9 m and re-rendered for v2
why: Own review of the v1 contact sheet: car read ~45 % of frame width in the exploded view (240SX reviewer flagged the same); 5.0 m clipped the bumpers side-on in a preview, so side-on stays at 6.9 m

decision: v2 delivered: /home/user/media/work/sera/out/toyota_sera_v2.mp4 (39.27 s, 1080x1920 30 fps); self-review in review.md; archived to training/examples/toyota-sera
why: Tighter explode is the only change from v1; cuts re-measured (-2 ms from every beat), no black frames, panels in frame

decision: v3 plan (user's v2 brief via the parent session; projects/toyota-sera/direction.md + director.md): whole car front-right 3/4 push -> front wheel (reused) -> front section held (hood opens, front bumper slides toward camera and tips its scanned inner face up over the crash structure) -> side: both butterfly doors, side-on into the cabin -> rear: rear bumper off + inner face over the rear structure -> progressive explode G1 front assembly (front-left) / G2 doors + rear bumper (left side) / G3 reassembly rear-left, swap to clean car on the lock, fade -> small logo
why: Brief: order by this car's scan features, travel front->side->rear, one section per shot with the part shown off, no wasted rotations, whole car at the open, progressive explode over several angles, short fade, small logo. Director report flagged s1~s2/s5/s6 and s6~s7 as repeated views

decision: Cut from v2: s1 turntable, s2 rear orbit, s4 nose, s7 rotating top-down, the all-at-once s8 explode; s5 hood merged into one held front shot; s6 doors re-rendered side-on
why: Brief items 2/3: wasted rotations, repeated views (IoU 0.65-0.81), ping-pong front->rear->front, grille holes in s4

decision: Parts tip only where their back is scanned: front bumper +90 deg about X, rear bumper -90 deg, each after sliding 1.2 m toward the camera into clear background; explode panels translate only
why: Brief item 5 + promoted rules: spin only to show the backside; inner faces + mounting tabs exist in both bumper part scans (looked at reg/*_alone renders); move parts out of the body's silhouette

decision: Section bases: front_base (front bumper + hood off; front-bumper-removed + hood-open states underneath), rear_base (rear bumper off; rear-bumper-removed state) via explode_base.py --only
why: Each section shows only its own removal; the scan of what's underneath fills every removed area (brief item 6). The refactored tool reproduces the v2 explode base byte-for-byte

decision: Opening pushes 6.8 -> 5.6 m: car 73-75 % of frame width, whole car in frame from frame 1
why: Brief item 4 (v1/v2 openings too cropped); measured silhouette width on the preview, not estimated
